plan.summary: This 4-week block starts the 12-week off-camp parent cycle for boxing with a simple build-first approach: a little explosive work, one main strength lift, then brief upper-body pulling and trunk work. Week 1 establishes a training max for the primary lift so percentage work can start cleanly in Week 2. With only one 30-minute S&C session per week, the plan keeps volume tight and quality high so it supports boxing without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic force and power with simple lifts and crisp explosive work that fit around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength work and keep power output sharp without letting fatigue drift up.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the work toward fast, sharp outputs while holding onto the strength built earlier.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a box height that lets every rep stay clean and quiet. Step down each rep and reset fully before the next jump.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if box setup is awkward. Jump for height and land softly.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you want an even simpler option. Start from a controlled shallow dip.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then work up to one hard top set of 3-5 reps with solid form. This session establishes your baseline for future percentage work, so stop if technique slips.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

substitutionOptions.name: Block Pull
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the trap bar is unavailable. Keep the same hard but clean top set of 3-5 reps.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the heaviest clean top set and keep the bar path smooth.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a steady load and pause briefly at the top of each rep. Keep the chest planted and do not yank the weight.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the chest-supported bench is taken. Keep the torso still.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need a simple free-weight option. Match reps on both sides.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Only roll as far as you can keep the ribs down and lower back quiet. Move slow out, strong back in.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no ab wheel is available. Keep the range short and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Cable Crunch
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if rollouts irritate the shoulders or lower back.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Jump with intent and land softly. Stop the set if height drops or landings get noisy.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the box is not practical. Focus on crisp takeoff and balanced landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Trap Bar Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only with a light load and clean mechanics. Keep every rep fast.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.notes: Drive hard from the floor and finish tall without leaning back. Rest enough to keep all reps clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Block Pull
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the trap bar is unavailable. Match the same loading pattern.

performanceTarget.prompt: Track the best clean work set and keep bar speed steady across all sets.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Use a load you can control for all reps. Pull elbows back and keep the neck relaxed.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if you need a quicker setup.

substitutionOptions.name: T-Bar Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if a chest-supported row station is unavailable.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Press straight out and resist rotation. Keep the ribs down and hips square.

substitutionOptions.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if the standing version feels unstable.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Carry
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if cables are busy. Walk slow and stay tall.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
